title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Spend and the Ridgeline Tool Rental Damage Protection Limit
content:
Spending on a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account raises the protection limit applied to a disputed Ridgeline Tool Rental damage repair charge.

**Rule.** Card spend raises the protection limit of the agreement: when the purchases posted to the renter's Ridgeline Consumer Credit account in the last 12 months total 5000.00 dollars or more, 1500.00 dollars are added; when they total 2000.00 dollars or more but less than 5000.00 dollars, 500.00 dollars are added; when they total less than 2000.00 dollars, nothing is added.

**Window.** A purchase falls in the last 12 months when it is dated fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day the adjustment is booked. Every purchase posted to the account counts, whatever the channel.

The amount is added to the protection limit of the agreement, against which the protected repair cost is measured; no amount on the way to the adjustment is rounded, the adjustment being rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Spend bands

| Purchases posted in the last 12 months | Added to the protection limit |
|---|---|
| 5000.00 or more | 1500.00 |
| 2000.00 up to 4999.99 | 500.00 |
| below 2000.00 | nothing |

## Hypothetical readings (adjustment booked on 1 December 2026)

| Purchases on the account | Counted total | Added |
|---|---|---|
| 3200.00 on 2 December 2025, 1800.00 on 4 May 2026 | 5000.00 | 1500.00 |
| 3200.00 on 1 December 2025, 1800.00 on 4 May 2026 | 1800.00 (the first is 12 whole months before) | nothing |
| 2400.00 on 9 September 2026 | 2400.00 | 500.00 |
